audit.why: 55.56% over 171 games matches the arc: even at 1, Cassiopeia's from 2-3 through the first item because grounding removes his mobility, Yone's after two crit items. Side-lane and teamfight framing is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes are level-labelled but carry no cooldowns, so 'hold Miasma for his dash' has no timer attached.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s, Spirit Cleave 14s flat, Fate Sealed 120/100/80s. Those three numbers are what make 'when do I step up' answerable.
audit.corrected: Added Soul Unbound's 22s and Spirit Cleave's 14s to the cooldown breakdown and mid-game plan.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers describe Soul Unbound as an escape he chooses — 'E body-snap to rewind out', 'no E body-snap to bail' — and treat it as something Miasma grounds. Riot's text says the spirit is FORCED back to the body when the ability ends. It is not an escape he steers; it is a guaranteed return to a spot you can see.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body.' The kit file gives Soul Unbound no dash flag, so claiming Miasma grounds it is unsupported.
audit.corrected: Reframed it as a known destination — the body's location is where he will be, so hold the cloud and the fangs for that spot — and reserved the grounding claim for the Mortal Steel dash, which the kit does flag.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Cleave's shield is mentioned once, in the late paragraph, as a scaling nuisance.
audit.why: It is a 14-second shield that grows with champions hit, and a Twin Fang chain dumped into a fresh one accomplishes nothing. Forcing it out is the trade sequencing of the whole lane.
audit.corrected: Told you to bait Spirit Cleave and start the fang chain after it, with the 14s number.

edits.before: Your Q-then-E prime comes online and W grounds his Q3 dash and his E body-snap, so he cannot gap-close in or rewind out of your chained Twin Fangs.
edits.after: Your Q-then-E prime comes online and Miasma grounds his Mortal Steel dash, so he cannot gap-close into your chained Twin Fang or leave the cloud.

edits.before: Hold Miasma for his Q3 dash or E body-snap, ground him in the cloud, then chain Twin Fang on the poisoned target
edits.after: Hold Miasma for his Mortal Steel dash, ground him inside the cloud, then chain Twin Fang on the poisoned target

edits.before: Save Q3 dash to gap-close and E body-snap to rewind out, baiting your Miasma so he is ungrounded on the all-in
edits.after: Use the Mortal Steel dash to close and Soul Unbound to reach you, baiting your Miasma so he is ungrounded on the all-in

edits.before: Your full Q-W-E combo and move-speed kiting come online — Miasma grounds his dash and E body-snap so he can neither close nor rewind out of your chained Twin Fangs.
edits.after: Your full Q-W-E combo and move-speed kiting come online — Miasma grounds the Mortal Steel dash, and Soul Unbound only ever returns him to his body, so he cannot leave your poison.

edits.before: Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs, and any extended trade favors you once Miasma locks down his mobility.
edits.after: Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang, and any extended trade favours you once Miasma locks his dash down.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — you have one ability and no poison to prime, and his Spirit Cleave (a frontal cleave, not point-and-click) trades fine into your lone Q. But once you hit 2-3 the lane tilts your way: drop a Q to poison him, E for the empowered Twin Fang, and hold Miasma for the moment he commits his Q3 dash. Grounding him mid-dash strands him in the cloud with no E body-snap to bail, and your move-speed passive plus the Q speed buff mean he cannot Cleave-and-walk back out. Sidestep his Spirit Cleave cone and never stand in it while you fang him.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — you have one ability and no poison to prime, and his Spirit Cleave (a frontal cleave, not point-and-click) trades fine into your lone Q. Once you hit 2-3 the lane tilts your way: drop a Q to poison him, E for the empowered Twin Fang, and hold Miasma for the moment he commits the Mortal Steel dash. Grounded mid-dash he is stranded in the cloud, and Serpentine Grace plus the Q speed buff mean he cannot Cleave-and-walk back out. Sidestep the Spirit Cleave cone and never stand in it while you fang him.

edits.before: This is your window. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fangs, and Miasma is a hard answer to his whole mobility kit — grounded, there is no Q3 gap-close and no E body-snap escape. Lay the cloud on his path, prime with Q, and fang him until he breaks. At 6, Petrifying Gaze checks his Fate Sealed: if he dashes in facing you, your cone stuns him before the knockup goes off — but it needs him pointed at you, so hold it for his engage instead of firing it on cooldown. Force the all-ins here while you out-range and out-DPS him.
edits.after: This is your window. Ranks in Q and E let you chain near-continuous Twin Fang, and Miasma is the hard answer to his mobility — grounded, there is no Mortal Steel gap-close. Bait Spirit Cleave first: it shields him every 14 seconds, and a fang chain into a fresh shield is wasted. Soul Unbound is not an escape either — his spirit is forced back to his body, so the body's spot tells you exactly where to hold the cloud. At 6, Petrifying Gaze checks Fate Sealed if he dashes in facing you, so save it for his commit rather than firing it on cooldown.

edits.before: Miasma is the anti-dash button — ground his engage and the dive kit becomes a farm bot.
edits.after: Miasma is the anti-dash button — ground Mortal Steel and the dive kit becomes a farm bot.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Miasma for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, and the spirit is forced back to the body, so punish that spot. - Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s; bait it before the fangs. - Miasma is for the Mortal Steel dash.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in Soul Unbound range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — or burning the whole fang chain into a fresh Spirit Cleave shield.
